title: Sitcom Laugh Track
blurb: Canned studio laughter, declaring that a joke has occurred whether or not one actually has. Play it after anything and the anything retroactively becomes a punchline. Awkward silences. Bad news delivered cheerfully. Your own life decisions, all improved by an invisible audience finding them hilarious. The technique dates back to 1950s radio and was always faintly sinister, so using it ironically only makes the subtext text. Comedy's second-oldest special effect, after the fart.
origin: Classic canned studio-audience laughter from the sitcom era.
